SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.

3. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   D. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.

7. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
